name: Krita
title: Krita: free Clip Studio alternative
hook: Clip Studio Paint charges you twenty seven bucks a year to paint on your computer. This app does it for free.

features.say: Over a hundred brushes come ready to paint with.
A stabilizer smooths out your shaky lines.

caption:
Clip Studio Paint charges $27/year. Krita lets you paint and draw on your computer for free 🎨

✅ Over 100 brushes ready to use
✅ Brush stabilizer for smooth, steady lines
✅ Frame-by-frame animation with onion skinning
✅ No subscription, no paywall, 100% free

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux · Android
ℹ️ No iPhone or iPad version

Comment "PAINT" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day

#opensource #github #digitalart #drawing #illustration #krita #freeapps #techtips
dm_pitch: Krita, the free open-source Clip Studio Paint alternative 🎨
